data.one_liner: Send Linux desktop notifications via DBus.
data.what_it_does: This package provides a simple API to send notifications on Linux desktops using the desktop notifications specification. It wraps DBus calls and exposes a NotificationsClient for sending and closing notifications.
use_when: You need to display system notifications on a Linux desktop
You want a lightweight, null‑safe solution without extra dependencies
avoid_when: You target macOS, Windows, or mobile platforms
You need push notifications or in‑app messaging
strengths: No build_runner or code generation required
weaknesses: No support for other desktop environments
